positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Solo dev building AI first software.
 - Built gelaber.com, a language learning app that uses a texting and voice style interface to teach languages without rote memorization. 
 - Built an app for generating podcasts and doing deep dives on niche topics

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead a 3 person team to create backend app functionality in TypeScript
 - Configured AWS instances to support app deployments, our dev environments and new CI workflows (EC2, S3, GitHub Actions, Lambdas)
 - Refactored the entire backend to be more maintainable and extensible for future developers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote and launched a wholly new futures trading interface in TypeScript/React
- Built dozens of forms to handle regulated user information
- Built data intensive dashboards to display myriad financial data for management and operation of the exchange

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Reduced reliance on labor intensive one off pages by improving data modeling for an insurance form generation system
- Created an error management system, dozens of CRUD endpoints, and other scaffolding for a new serverless/Vite/React app

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote CSS + React/TypeScript front-ends to perfectly match design docs
•	Created providers, custom hooks and wrote other complex state code to manage auto loan applications efficiently and without error
•	Wrote back-end code in Node.js to manage user loans and applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote ReactJS/TypeScript to build a crypto gaming storefront, using hooks, state and routes, while paying close attention to structure quality and performance
•	Created dozens of custom components to match design standards and create a cohesive experience
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Growth Lead, Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Managed growth efforts at a new social network, called Remix
•	Designed and launched a creator program, writing copy, creating marketing materials, and managing communications with hundreds of creators
•	Created viral content to promote app installs, reaching millions of impressions
•	Prototyped and built new products, precisely implementing Figma designs in ReactJS/TypeScript
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Derivatives Sales Intern
positions.description:
• Wrote blog posts explaining strategies using Cboe products
• Built slide decks describing products for market participants
• Learned Salesforce, updated sales data
• Participated in sales meetings with prospective exchange customers

positions.title: Pricing Intern
positions.description:
- Summarized academic and market research to inform fee decisions on futures and options
 - Calculated revenue impact of transaction fee changes
 - Provided updates on cryptocurrency market developments to keep the Pricing team informed
 - Created statistical analyses of exchange liquidity programs to inform strategy choices

positions.title: Active Trader Services Intern
positions.description:
- Familiarized myself with advanced derivatives strategies, including with options and futures contracts
 - Collaborated with a national team to produce a conceptual presentation for E*Trade executives
 - Learned data analysis and visualization methods with Excel, as well as process automation and macros

honors.title: Klett Langenscheidt Award
honors.description: An award given to a German student for an excellent German language interview.
